sql: SELECT (SELECT win_rate FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_close_quarter WHERE quarter='2026-Q2') - (SELECT win_rate FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_close_quarter WHERE quarter='2026-Q1')
SELECT count(*) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE stage_id='contractsent' AND NOT is_closed AND created_quarter < '2026-Q4'
SELECT sum(deals_reached_to)*1.0/sum(deals_reached_from) FROM main.mart_stage_conversion WHERE from_stage='Qualified to buy' AND to_stage='Presentation scheduled'
SELECT won_amount*1.0/deals_won FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_close_quarter WHERE quarter='2026-Q3'
SELECT sum(deals_won) FROM main.mart_owner_win_rate WHERE owner_name='Sales rep B' AND quarter LIKE '2026-%'
SELECT sum(amount) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_lost AND closed_quarter='2026-Q3'
SELECT change_since_reported FROM main.mart_win_rate_reported_vs_now WHERE quarter='2026-Q1'
SELECT share_still_open FROM main.mart_win_rate_by_created_cohort WHERE cohort_quarter='2026-Q3'
SELECT count(*) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE closed_quarter='2026-Q2' AND was_moved_back
SELECT median(days_to_close) FROM main.fct_deals WHERE is_won AND closed_quarter LIKE '2026-%'
